data.rationale: huffman_tree_create_lengths() declares 'unsigned int blcount[MAX_BIT_LENGTH]' (15 entries, valid indices 0..14; MAX_BIT_LENGTH==15 per private-lib-core.h:864) and increments 'blcount[bitlen[bits]]++' at line 253. The bitlen values come from the dynamic-Huffman block parser in _lws_upng_inflate_data(): at line 570-574 any decoded code-length symbol <= 15 is stored (the guard is 'if (inf->code > 15) return fatal'), so a bit length of 15 is legal and indexes blcount[15], one element past the stack array. Note the companion array nextcode[] is declared MAX_BIT_LENGTH + 1, confirming blcount[] is the undersized one. Reachability from the fuzz target: LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput -> lws_api_test_gunzip -> lws_upng_inflate_data -> _lws_upng_inflate_data case UPNS_ID_BL_GB_BTYPE_2e -> huffman_tree_create_lengths(&inf->ct, inf->bitlen) (line 539) with fully attacker-controlled bitlen[]. Empirically confirmed: a 100s libFuzzer run against /out/lws_upng_inflate_fuzzer produced 'AddressSanitizer: stack-buffer-overflow ... upng-gzip.c:253:24 in huffman_tree_create_lengths', called from upng-gzip.c:539. Fix direction: declare blcount[MAX_BIT_LENGTH + 1] (and keep clenc/bitlen domains <= 15).
